message.content: {"ranking": [], "explanation": "No candidate edits the write-path logic that controls when frames are committed to memory and made visible to the read side. The observed failure is m_axis_tvalid asserting 1 at cycles 13-15 when the reference expects 0, indicating that a frame was published that should have been dropped or never committed. All candidates either modify unrelated generate-block conditions, reset initialization of rd_addr_reg (which is assigned combinatorially before use), or add qualifiers to conditions that do not gate the frame-commit decision (wr_ptr_next = wr_ptr_cur_reg + 1). None address the core issue: the write-side frame-commit condition at line ~7249 lacks a guard to suppress commitment when a bad-frame drop is pending or when the frame is invalid. Since no candidate touches this mechanism, none can resolve the m_axis_tvalid mismatch."}
